ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level ratio; approximately 75% high-intensity (off-white/cream) to 25% low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid low-intensity black pigmentation originates at the peduncle junction and extends in a continuous thin ribbon along the entire trailing edge; scattered low-intensity speckles and medium-intensity tan mottling are distributed across the high-intensity central lobe fields.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped depression with a pixel-calculated angle of approximately 45 degrees at the central lobe convergence.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile; characterized by numerous jagged peaks and valleys (3-15 pixel amplitude) across the entire boundary, with a prominent deep notch on the distal third of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature on the leading/outer lateral edges; trailing edges follow a complex, irregular path with overall slight concavity towards the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense spatial clusters of high-intensity circular pixel groups (barnacles) concentrated heavily on the left and right distal tips; secondary scattered individual circular markers across the ventral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant irregular jagged indentation on the trailing edge of the right lobe; heavy colonization of calcified organisms along the distal perimeters.
other_distinctive_markers: Widespread yellowish-tan pixel staining (bio-fouling) concentrated on the lower interior regions of both high-intensity lobes.
